cafe.name: Café
cafe.blurb: Food and drink. Daily customers, ingredients, rent, staff and a rival down the road.

expand.label: Open a second café ($60,000)
expand.help: Fit-out and equipment for a second location. It takes a few months to find regulars.

1.title: The coffee cart
1.story: A coffee cart outside a busy station. Coffee you don't sell is poured away.
1.text: Have $35,000 in cash by the end.

2.title: Your first café
2.story: Your first café: rent, staff and a menu. Expect early losses while people find you.
2.text: Profit 3 months in a row, without running out of cash.

3.title: The café across the road
3.story: A rival café opens across the road and reacts to your prices.
3.text: After the rival opens, make $3,000+ profit 3 months in a row.

4.title: Running the books
4.story: The full picture: equipment, supplier bills, seasons, loans and surprises.

5.title: A second café
5.story: Grow into two cafés: borrow, take investment, or grow from profit.
5.text: Open a second café and make your share worth $300,000.

saas.name: Software subscription
saas.blurb: Monthly subscriptions. Sign-ups, cancellations, developers, marketing and investors.

expand.label: Build an enterprise sales team ($15,000)
expand.help: Unlocks sales reps who win large companies on bigger contracts.

1.title: Your first app
1.story: A small app people pay for monthly. Cheaper wins sign-ups; each pays less.

2.title: Growing the startup
2.story: Buy ads and hire developers. Better products win more and keep more.
2.text: A profitable month with $25,000+ MRR, without running out of cash.

3.title: Two plans, one rival
3.story: Two plans and a rival who reacts to your Pro price.
3.text: Reach $30,000 MRR with under 4.5% of customers leaving a month.

4.title: Cash is not revenue
4.story: Yearly plans bring cash early, but you still owe the service.
4.text: Reach $50,000 MRR in a profitable month.

5.title: Raise or bootstrap
5.story: Raise money to grow faster, or keep more and grow on profit.

shop.name: Online store
shop.blurb: Selling backpacks online. Stock bought ahead, shipping, returns, ads and ratings.

expand.label: Launch a second product line ($25,000)
expand.help: Design and samples for a new range. Brings more visitors once it’s known.

1.title: Your first stock order
1.story: Sell backpacks online. Bags cost $24; unsold ones hold your cash.
1.text: Have $15,000 in cash by the end.

2.title: Ads, shipping and returns
2.story: Shipping, fees, returns and ads. New stores take time to be found.
2.text: Profit 3 months in a row, without running out of cash.

3.title: Ratings and rivals
3.story: Your star rating sells bags. A rival fights on price.
3.text: After the rival appears, $2,500+ profit 3 months in a row, rating 4.0+.

4.title: The holiday rush
4.story: Stock arrives a month late. The holidays bring huge demand.

5.title: Scaling the store
5.story: Grow with a new product line, a loan or an investor.

agency.name: Service agency
agency.blurb: A design studio. Billable hours, hourly or fixed prices, and clients who pay late.

expand.label: Open a second studio ($30,000)
expand.help: A second studio in another city. Brings new clients once it’s known.

1.title: Going freelance
1.story: A freelance designer with 120 hours a month. Too cheap: busy and poor. Too dear: no work.
1.text: Have $50,000 in cash by the end.

2.title: Hiring your first designers
2.story: Hire designers. Salaries are paid with or without work.
2.text: Profit 3 months in a row, without running out of cash.

3.title: Clients and competitors
3.story: Charge by the hour or the project. Cheap freelancers compete for small clients.
3.text: After the rivals appear, $12,000+ profit 3 months in a row.

4.title: Waiting to be paid
4.story: Clients pay 30–60 days late. You can profit and still run out of cash.

5.title: Building a studio business
5.story: Open a second studio, borrow, or bring in an investor.
5.text: Open a second studio and make your share worth $900,000.

4.title: My idea
4.text: Profit 3 months in a row within 24 months, without running out of cash.
